newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle higher in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle higher in technical correction.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended firmer on a technical bounce amid thin and featureless trade, market sources said.
"We had a technical correction from an oversold condition but there was really no momentum," Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter, said.
The market awaits the weekly movement number, released later today, and Friday's monthly USDA estimates of the Florida crop.
The USDA report is not expected to provide any fresh inspiration to the market, however, as an anticipated rise in yields has already been filtered into prices, analysts said.
The Florida box count is expected to remain unchanged at 222 million 90-lb boxes.
The USDA will release its report at 0830 EDT.
May closed up 0.40 to 74.00 cents, while the back months settled 0.70 to 0.20 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 1,700 lots compared with Wednesday's official 2,636 lots.
Support in May was pegged at 72.50 cents and resistance at 76.00, the high reached earlier this week.
